chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 120C - Lobbying: NC's post-2006-reform consolidated lobbying-disclosure regime (registration, expenditure reporting, gift restrictions).

notes: Excluded Chapter 138A (State Government Ethics Act) — officials-side ethics regime, not lobbyist disclosure (matches NC 2010 subagent decision). NC's General Statutes are organized by top-level chapter (no titles above chapter level); Chapter 120C is the title-level entry point for lobbying.
